newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 10.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 10.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 119.88 points or 1.51 percent to close at 7842.43 on profit taking in blue chip issues.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index plunged 24.53 points or 2.32 percent to 1,028.16 on fears on rising domestic interest rates and a volatile ringgit.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5028/38 a dollar at around 0100 GMT, about even from its Kuala Lumpur ending on Wednesday at 2.5033/43.
* Sentiment remains weak with market seen softer, analysts said.
* Eyes will be focused on money market interest rates to see how Bank Negara's comments that it would allow rates to rise to protect the ringgit will filter through.
* Technically, the index should continue to test lower with support near the 1,020 level and resistance at 1,050 points, said Elliot Wave International chartist John Sowden.
* Food products firm S&P Food said it was buying a 20 percent stake in plastic products maker Ralco Corp.
